name: Line Chart
keywords: line trend time series continuous progress over time
use_case: Show trends over time continuous data
accessibility_notes: Provide text summary of trend direction; keyboard-navigate points
anti_patterns: Connecting unrelated discrete data points; too many overlapping lines (max 4-5)

name: Bar Chart Vertical
keywords: bar vertical comparison categories discrete
accessibility_notes: Label bars with values; provide data table alternative
anti_patterns: Too many bars; rotating x-axis labels on mobile

name: Bar Chart Horizontal
keywords: bar horizontal comparison long labels ranking
use_case: Compare with long category labels or ranking
accessibility_notes: Better for mobile - no rotated labels
anti_patterns: Using for time series data

name: Grouped Bar Chart
keywords: grouped comparison multiple series side by side
accessibility_notes: Use patterns + color for series; legend required
anti_patterns: Too many groups causing overcrowding

name: Stacked Bar Chart
keywords: stacked proportion composition part whole
accessibility_notes: Include total and individual values in tooltip
anti_patterns: Stacking many thin segments; using for precise comparison

name: Area Chart
keywords: area filled trend volume cumulative below line
use_case: Show volume or cumulative trend over time
accessibility_notes: Fill area reduces readability with many series; use patterns
anti_patterns: Overlapping areas without transparency; too many series

name: Scatter Plot
keywords: scatter correlation relationship two variables points
accessibility_notes: Provide regression line or annotation; alt text for outliers
anti_patterns: Overcrowding with 1000s of points; using for categorical

name: Bubble Chart
keywords: bubble three variables size dimension correlation
accessibility_notes: Size scale must be labeled; tooltip with all 3 values
anti_patterns: Bubbles too small to tap on mobile; overlapping without opacity

name: Pie Chart
keywords: pie proportion slice percentage part whole
accessibility_notes: Include percentage labels; provide table alternative
anti_patterns: More than 5 slices; using for comparison; 3D pie (always wrong)

name: Donut Chart
keywords: donut proportion ring center metric kpi
accessibility_notes: Center value must have clear label; slices need labels
anti_patterns: Too many slices; using color alone to differentiate

name: Heatmap
keywords: heatmap matrix density frequency calendar patterns
use_case: Show density or frequency in a matrix
accessibility_notes: Color scale legend required; colorblind-safe palette; text values in cells
anti_patterns: Using red-green palette; cells too small to tap on mobile

name: Treemap
keywords: treemap hierarchy size proportion nested
use_case: Show hierarchical data with size proportions
accessibility_notes: Labels only in larger cells; provide drill-down; alt table
anti_patterns: No drill-down for deep hierarchies; tiny unreadable cells

name: Funnel Chart
keywords: funnel conversion stages drop-off pipeline sales
accessibility_notes: Label each stage with count and percentage
anti_patterns: Unclear stage labels; missing drop-off percentages

name: Sankey Diagram
keywords: sankey flow connections nodes relationships network
use_case: Show flow and connections between nodes
accessibility_notes: High complexity - always provide data table; tooltip on each flow
anti_patterns: Using for simple comparisons; too many crossing links

name: Radar/Spider Chart
keywords: radar spider comparison multi-axis metrics attributes
accessibility_notes: Label each axis clearly; don't use for precise comparison
anti_patterns: Too many overlapping series; axes with different scales

name: Gauge/Dial Chart
keywords: gauge dial meter kpi single metric progress circular
use_case: Display single metric against a target
accessibility_notes: Show numeric value prominently alongside gauge; clear min/max
anti_patterns: Using for comparisons; no clear target or scale

name: Sparkline
keywords: sparkline mini inline trend context table row
use_case: Inline mini trend chart within text or tables
accessibility_notes: Include data range as text alternative; not for precise reading
anti_patterns: Using sparklines as primary analysis chart; too small to interpret

name: Candlestick Chart
keywords: candlestick ohlc stock finance trading price
accessibility_notes: Provide OHLC values in tooltip; colorblind-safe: use shapes too
anti_patterns: Using for non-financial data; no volume indicator

name: Histogram
keywords: histogram distribution frequency bins continuous
accessibility_notes: Label bin ranges clearly; provide summary stats as text
anti_patterns: Using for discrete categorical data; unequal bin sizes

name: Box Plot
keywords: box plot whisker quartile distribution outliers
accessibility_notes: Explain median/IQR in tooltip; label outlier points
anti_patterns: Audience must understand box plot; without explanation

name: Waterfall Chart
keywords: waterfall bridge financial incremental cumulative
use_case: Show incremental changes to running total
accessibility_notes: Color-code positive/negative with shapes too; show totals clearly
anti_patterns: Unclear which bars are incremental vs total

name: Gantt Chart
keywords: gantt timeline project schedule tasks dates
use_case: Show project schedule and task dependencies
accessibility_notes: Include text list of tasks as table; keyboard navigation for tasks
anti_patterns: Non-interactive Gantt for editable projects; poor mobile UX

name: Network Graph
keywords: network graph nodes edges relationships connections
accessibility_notes: Very complex - require text explanation; filter/highlight nodes
anti_patterns: Dense networks without filtering; no interaction on mobile

name: Calendar Heatmap
keywords: calendar heatmap activity github contribution daily
use_case: Show activity or values by date calendar view
accessibility_notes: Include color scale; provide text summary of peak activity periods
anti_patterns: Too many years without zoom; tiny cells on mobile

name: Timeline
keywords: timeline events milestones chronological history sequential
use_case: Show events chronologically on a timeline
accessibility_notes: Events must be keyboard navigable; tooltip for each event
anti_patterns: Too many events without grouping; no zoom/filter for dense timelines
